content.shortDescription: Calcula el pago mensual de tu préstamo FHA incluyendo prima de seguro hipotecario (MIP) inicial y mensual.
content.shortDescription_en: Calculate your FHA mortgage payment including upfront and annual Mortgage Insurance Premium (MIP).
content.longDescription: Estima el costo mensual de financiar una vivienda bajo el programa hipotecario FHA (Federal Housing Administration). Incorpora el enganche mínimo del 3.5% y la prima de seguro hipotecario (Upfront MIP y Annual MIP).
content.longDescription_en: Estimate monthly cost of financing home purchase under Federal Housing Administration (FHA) loan program. Factors in 3.5% min down payment, upfront MIP, and annual MIP insurance.
howToUse: Ingresa el precio de la propiedad y la divisa activa.
Indica la tasa de interés anual (%) y el plazo en años.
Consulta el pago mensual total con seguro MIP incluido.
howToUse_en: Enter property price and active currency.
Enter interest rate (%) and loan term in years.
View total monthly FHA payment including MIP insurance fees.
content.methodology: Cálculo FHA: Financiación = (Precio - Enganche) + Upfront MIP (1.75%). Pago mensual = Cuota Base + Annual MIP (0.55% / 12).
content.methodology_en: FHA Calculation: Financed Amount = (Price - Down Payment) + Upfront MIP (1.75%). Monthly Payment = Base + Annual MIP (0.55% / 12).

guideSections.title: FHA Loan Program Basics
guideSections.content_html_en: FHA loans are government-backed mortgages designed for first-time buyers or buyers with lower credit scores, requiring a minimum down payment of just 3.5%.
guideSections.content_html: Los préstamos FHA están respaldados por el gobierno y exigen una entrada mínima del 3.5%, facilitando el acceso a compradores primerizos.
